pie: dyéw nos ph₂ter ḱludʰí h₁yós n̥bʰróm dédeh₃si. h₁yós nos bʰéh₂os h₁opéyesi. dʰéǵʰom nos méh₂ter ḱléwse. h₁yéh₂ gʷṓs h₂élesi h₁yéh₂ pérwr̥h₂ bʰéresi. h₁wésu nos ḱléwos dh₃dʰí. méh₂ter nos Hréwgʰim h₂wĺ̥h₁neh₂m-kʷe duh₃dʰí.
english: Father Sky, hear us! You who give rain, you who give light to us! Mother Earth, listen to us! You who nourish the cattle, you who carry the mountains! Give us good fame. Mother, give us rye and wool.

pie: méh₂ter toy h₂éǵrom h₂éryomes. h₁uséwih₂ nos h₁sdʰí Hrugʰís-kʷe bʰuh₂yéh₁t. séh₁mn̥-kʷe h₂éboles-kʷe bʰuh₂ih₁ént. wĺ̥kʷos nos mē gʷm̥yóyh₁t. ḱwṓ h₂ówins ph₂syéh₁t n̥bʰrós Hrugʰéy h₂ur̥syéh₁t. méh₂ter toy médʰu dédeh₃omes.
english: Mother, we plough your field. Be good to us, and may the rye grow, and the seed and the apples. May the wolf not come to us. May the dog protect the sheep. May the rain-cloud rain on the rye. We shall give you mead, Mother.

pie: sh₂wéns dʰugh₂tḗr dʰubróy mréy séngʷt. méh₂tēr swéh₂m dʰugh₂térm̥ h₂isḱét. h₂uséy h₂éǵt. h₂éwsos tā́m widés? nu h₂éwsōs tósyeh₂ey wérh₁t. tā́m widóm. h₂én séngʷt. nu méh₂tēr yemHóybʰos sékʷt. yemHóh₁ tā́m mréys spr̥tóm. nu yemHóh₁ tā́m ḱlutā́m. h₁éḱwōys wéǵʰomh₁noh₁ tóh₁ móri gʷm̥tā́m. nu dʰugh₂térm̥ h₁ptā́m tā́m-kʷe mréys h₁éǵʰs duktā́m. séh₂ spr̥tó. nu méh₂tēr méwdt yemHóybʰos-kʷe h₁wésu ḱléwos déh₃ut.
english: The Sun's daughter sank in the deep sea. The mother sought her own daughter. She said to Dawn: "Dawn, did you see her?" Dawn said to her: "I saw her. She sank there." Then the mother said to the twins: "Twins, rescue her from the sea!" The twins heard her. Carried by horses, they came to the sea. They seized the daughter, and drew her out of the sea. She was rescued. The mother rejoiced, and gave good fame to the twins.

pie: kʷís gʷréh₂um dyḗm upér tn̥néwt? kʷís dʰéǵʰōm Hn̥dʰí logʰéyet? kʷís wódr̥h₂ dʰubróm móri séh₁t? kʷís HéHḱu bʰéh₂os upér kʷért? méǵh₂s deywós dyḗm tn̥néwt. tā́m-kʷe Hn̥dʰí logʰéyet. téh₂-kʷe móri séh₁t bʰéh₂os-kʷe kʷért. kʷésmōy deywṓy médʰu déh₃omes? tósmey médʰu dédeh₃omes.
english: Who stretched out the heavy sky above? Who laid the earth below? Who let the waters go to the deep sea? Who made swift light above? The great god stretched out the sky, and laid her below, and let them go to the sea, and made light. To which god shall we give mead? To him we shall give mead.

pie: ǵʰéwtōr tom h₃rḗǵm̥ wewked: "h₁yáǵeswo deywóm wérunom".
english: The priest said to the king: "Pray to the god Werunos."

pie: h₂ówis h₁ékʷoybʰyos wewked: "dʰǵʰémonm̥ spéḱyoh₂ h₁éḱwoms-kʷe h₂áǵeti, ḱḗr moy agʰnutor".
english: The sheep said to the horses: "My heart pains me, seeing a man driving horses."

pie: deywṓs nos déywih₂es-kʷe ḱluté. h₁yóy dyéwi tḱité h₁yóy wr̥sménsu sédyete. h₁yóy dʰubréh₂ wódr̥h₂ pér h₁ité. ǵʰutóm wos médʰu dédh₃mes. ph₂sté nos gʷówes nos kéh₂ilōs h₁sih₁ént. HéHḱuns nos h₁éḱwons duh₃té.
english: Gods and goddesses, hear us! You who dwell in the sky, you who sit on the heights, you who go through the deep waters! We give you the poured mead. Protect us! May our cattle be healthy. Give us swift horses!

pie: swésōr bʰréh₂tr̥s wéwket. kʷís h₁ógʷʰim kélh₂t? nu bʰréh₂tēr tósyeh₂ey wérh₁t. n̥bʰrósyo déh₃tōr h₁ógʷʰim kélh₂t. séh₂ sékʷt. kʷíh₁ téwkt? h₂ḱnéh₁ gʰrómoh₁-kʷe téwkt. tóm tukónts só wódr̥h₂ sélǵt. nu séh₂ h₂éǵt. h₁ógʷʰis mért? só mért wódr̥h₂-kʷe móri dʰénh₂t. nu séh₂ wérh₁yet. tósyo h₁nómn̥ ḱlutóm h₁ésti.
english: The sister said to the brother: "Who struck the serpent?" Then the brother said to her: "The giver of rain struck the serpent." She said: "With what did he strike it?" "With a stone and with thunder," said the brother. "Having struck it, he released the waters." Then she said: "Did the serpent die?" "It died, and the waters ran to the sea." Then she said: "His name is famous."

pie: péh₂wr̥ deywṓys ḱóm h₁ést. tód h₂nr̥bʰís ḱóm ne h₁ést. nu h₂nḗr deywṓm pérwr̥ gʷéh₂t. péh₂wr̥ h₁pónts só tód gʷr̥h₂éwi h₂ḱméni ḱélet. nu só ní h₁éyt só-kʷe swidyét. dyḗws tóm kʷéḱt tósmey-kʷe h₂éǵt. péh₂wr̥ h₂ew duh₃dʰí. nu só wérh₁t. tód h₂ew ne déh₃woh₂. nu só tóm gʰrómoh₁ pért só-kʷe bʰindth₂é. tód tóns h₂ew gʷéh₂t. nu tóy tód h₂ḱméni h₂isḱónti.
english: Fire was with the gods. It was not with men. Then a man went to the mountain of the gods. Having seized the fire, he hid it in a heavy stone. Then he went down, and sweated. Sky saw him, and said to him: "Give the fire back!" Then he answered: "I shall not give it back." Then he struck it with thunder, and it split. And it went back to them. Now they seek it in the stone.

pie: Hrugʰís térst gʷówes-kʷe tr̥syónt tóy-kʷe swidyónt. nu h₂néres dyḗm spéḱyont. tóy h₂ǵént. n̥bʰrós kúdʰe h₁ésti? nu n̥bʰrós wr̥sméns mélh₃t. n̥bʰrós h₂wérst. sréwmn̥h₂ pléh₁t Hrugʰís-kʷe h₂wékst. h₂éboles sph₁rṓs h₁sént. nu tóy mudént.
english: The rye dried up, and the cattle were thirsty, and they sweated. Then the men looked at the sky. They said: "Where is the rain-cloud?" Then the cloud came from the height. The cloud rained. The streams filled, and the rye grew. The apples were thriving. Then they rejoiced.

pie: h₂éwsōs témHesos mélh₃t. séh₂ h₁rudʰéh₁t. diwés dʰugh₂tḗr h₁ést. nu dyḗws tā́m widét só-kʷe méwdt. nu tósyeh₂s bʰéh₂os pró h₁r̥sḱét. ǵʰh₂éns bʰéwdʰt séh₂-kʷe gʷṓs woǵéyet. témHos néḱt. nu só tósyeh₂ey ḱlutóm h₁nómn̥ dʰéh₁t.
english: Dawn came forth out of the darkness. She was red. She was the daughter of Sky. Then Sky saw her, and he rejoiced. Her light went forth. The goose woke up, and she awakened the cattle. The darkness vanished. Then he set a famous name on her.

pie: n̥bʰrósyo nos déywe gʷm̥dʰí. méǵh₂s h₁ési n̥bʰróm nos bʰére. h₁ógʷʰim gʷʰn̥dʰí h₁yós wódr̥h₂ Hwért mē nos linékʷs. wékʷos moy ḱléwse h₂ówins nos ph₂sdʰí. wĺ̥kʷos tā́s mē h₁dyéh₁t gʷówes nos gʷíh₃woyh₁ent. Hrugʰéys-kʷe nos sph₁rós h₁syéh₁t. nu toy médʰu déh₃omes.
english: God of the rain-cloud, come to us! You are great. Bring rain to us! Slay the serpent who shut in the waters! Do not leave us! Hear our word! Protect our sheep! May the wolf not eat them. May our cattle live, and may our rye be thriving. Then we shall give you mead.

pie: gʰrómosyo déywe h₁yós h₁ógʷʰim h₂ḱnéh₁ kélh₂s. h₁yós wódr̥h₂ wr̥sméns sélǵs h₁yós gʷṓs spérs. h₁yós HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵesi. móri toy pedsú trémti. gʷréh₂um nos n̥bʰróm dédeh₃si. h₂éǵrons nos mē torséyes. ń̥dʰgʷʰitom toy ḱléwos gʷíh₃weti. nu nos n̥bʰrósyo déh₃tor ḱludʰí. gʷṓs nos h₁wésu ḱléwos-kʷe dh₃té.
english: God of thunder, you who struck the serpent with a stone, you who released the waters from the height, you who freed the cattle, you who drive swift horses! At your feet the sea trembles. You give us heavy rain. Do not make our fields dry! Your imperishable fame lives. Now, giver of rain, hear us! Give us cattle and good fame.

pie: yémHos sóh₂wl̥ h₁ludʰét. só sékʷt. sóh₂wl̥ moy toy dʰugh₂térm̥ h₁opéye. déḱm̥t toy gʷṓs kʷetwórn̥s h₁éḱwons-kʷe déh₃oh₂. nu ph₂tḗr wérh₁yet. ǵm̥rós moy h₁sdʰí. nu yémHos tóns déh₃ut ph₂tḗr-kʷe tósmey swéh₂m dʰugh₂térm̥ dédeh₃t. nu tóh₁ ph₃tā́m.
english: A twin arrived at the Sun. He said: "Sun, give me your daughter! I shall give you ten cattle and four horses." The father said: "Be my son-in-law." Then the twin gave them, and the father gave him his own daughter. Then the two of them drank.

pie: swésōr deywóm wr̥sméni widét séh₂-kʷe bʰéyh₂t. swṓy bʰréh₂trey wérh₁yet. kʷís só h₁ésti? nu bʰréh₂tēr tósyeh₂ey mléwHt. só n̥bʰrósyo déh₃tōr h₁ésti h₁ógʷʰim-kʷe gʷʰn̥sḱéti. nu séh₂ bʰéh₂t. tósmey h₁éḱwom déh₃womes. nu tóh₁ tósmey h₁éḱwom h₁opéyetām.
english: A sister saw a god on the height, and was afraid. She said to her own brother: "Who is he?" The brother said to her: "He is the giver of rain, and he strikes the serpent." Then she spoke: "Let us give him a stallion." Then the two of them gave him a stallion.

pie: gʰrómosyo deywós HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵet. gʰrómos yéh₂t n̥bʰrós-kʷe tóm sékʷeto. tósyo kʷékʷlōs kʷl̥h₁ént. h₁ógʷʰis tóm kʷéḱt. nu só trémt só-kʷe ní sérpet. gʷʰént h₁ógʷʰim. wódr̥h₂ térkh₂t. nu só h₂epó léytt.
english: The god of thunder drove swift horses. Thunder went, and the rain-cloud followed him. His wheels turned. Then the serpent saw him, and trembled, and crept down. He slew the serpent. He released the waters. Then he went away.

pie: h₂éwsos nos diwés dʰúgh₂ter lukdʰí. h₁yéh₂ témHos h₂epó h₂éǵesi. h₁yéh₂ nos h₂ew bʰowdʰéyesi. h₁yéh₂ gʷṓs h₂éǵrom wédʰesi. h₁yéh₂ upér h₂ew h₁rudʰéh₁si. bʰéh₂os toy h₁wésu h₁ésti. h₂éwsos nos bʰéh₂os h₁opéye.
english: Dawn, daughter of Sky, shine for us! You who drive away the darkness, you who awaken us again, you who lead the cattle to the field, you who are red above again! Your light is good. Dawn, give us light.

pie: HéHḱuh₁ nos yemHóh₁ gʷm̥tóm h₁yóh₁ nos mréys spr̥tóm. h₁yóh₁ HéHḱuns h₁éḱwons h₂éǵetes. h₁yóh₁ kʷékʷlom duktés h₁yóh₁ h₁éḱwons dm̥h₂tóm. yémHoh₁ nos ḱlutóm h₁éḱwons nos ph₂stóm. h₁éḱwōs nos kéh₂ilōs h₁sih₁ént. h₁uséwōm nos déh₃torh₁ h₁éḱwons h₁opéyetom.
english: Swift twins, come to us! You who rescued us from the sea, you who drive swift horses, you who draw the wheel, you who tame the horses! Twins, hear us! Protect our horses. May our horses be healthy. Givers of good things, give us horses!

pie: suHnús swṓy ph₂tréy sékʷt. kʷís dyḗm tetólh₂e? nu ph₂tḗr tósmey wérh₁yet. deywṓs tóm tetl̥h₂ḗr. súHnu upó spéḱye. nu suHnús sékʷt. kʷís deywóns péh₂sti? dyḗws ph₂tḗr tóns péh₂sti.
english: The son said to his father: "Who holds up the sky?" The father said to him: "The gods hold it up. Look up, son!" Then the son said: "And who protects the gods?" "Father Sky protects them."

pie: móri pléh₁dʰet péh₂wr̥-kʷe néḱt. nu h₂néres studént tóy-kʷe tr̥mént. tóy skʷént. kʷís nos péh₂wr̥ bʰérēti? nu ḱwṓ wérh₁yet. tód wos bʰérōh₂. nu ḱwṓ deywṓm wérsmn̥ h₁ért. péh₂wr̥ h₁pónts ḱwṓ h₂ew dʰénh₂t. nu tód tóns bʰéret. tóy tósmey mḗms bʰéront. só tód h₁édt. nu só tṓys ḱóm tḱéyti.
english: The sea swelled, and the fire vanished. Then the men became cold, and trembled. They said: "Who will bring us fire?" Then the dog said: "I shall bring it to you." The dog arrived at the height of the gods. Having seized the fire, the dog ran back. Then he carried it to them. They brought him meat. He ate it. Now he dwells with them.

pie: tod ḱeḱluwōs owis aǵrom ebʰuget.
english: Having heard this, the sheep fled into the plain.

pie: sh₂wéns dʰugh₂tḗr léwkt. nu dwóh₁ diwés suHnúh₁ h₁éḱwōys h₁ludʰétām. sóh₂wl̥ tósyeh₂ey h₂éǵt. tóh₁ te wn̥Htā́m. nu séh₂ wéwket. tṓys ḱóm gʷéh₂oh₂. nu tóybʰos tā́m h₁opéyet. séh₂ h₁uséwh₁ usménh₁ woséyeto séh₂-kʷe h₂r̥ǵn̥tóm wésto. tā́m h₂r̥ǵn̥tósyo kʷékʷloy dʰh₁tā́m tā́m-kʷe h₂epó wédʰetām. nu deywṓs médʰu píph₃ont tóy-kʷe mudént. nu h₂éwsōs léwkt. séh₂ h₁rudʰéh₁t nu sh₂wéns kʷékʷlos pró gʷéh₂t.
english: The Sun's daughter shone. Then the two sons of Sky arrived on horses. The Sun said to her: "They have grown fond of you." She said: "I shall go with them." Then he gave her to them. She dressed herself in a good garment, and wore silver. The two placed her on the chariot of silver, and led her away. The gods drank mead, and they rejoiced. Then Dawn shone. She was red. The wheel of the sun went forth.

pie: h₁ógʷʰis deywóm kélh₂t só-kʷe ní ḱéyto. nu deywósyo bʰréh₂tēr gʷm̥yét. tósmey wéwket. bʰréh₂ter sth₂dʰí h₁ógʷʰim-kʷe tukdʰí. nu só stéh₂t só-kʷe Hwérdʰt. tóh₁ h₁ógʷʰim stundtā́m só-kʷe mért. nu só wódr̥h₂ térkh₂t. tóysōm ḱléwos méǵh₂ h₁ést.
english: The serpent struck the god, and he lay down. Then the god's brother came. He said to him: "Brother, stand up, and strike the serpent!" He stood up, and grew strong. The two of them struck the serpent, and it died. Then he released the waters. Great was their fame.

pie: h₁n̥gʷnís deywóybʰos dʰénh₂t wédn̥su-kʷe séngʷt. nu deywṓs tóm h₂isḱónt. tóm ne widónt. ǵʰh₂éns snéh₂t. nu séh₂ tóm h₂én widét tóybʰos-kʷe mléwHt. h₁n̥gʷnís wédni h₁ésti. nu tóy wéwkont. h₁ń̥gʷni wédn̥s ml̥h₃dʰí. nu h₁n̥gʷnís sékʷt. h₁eǵ dedwóyh₂e. nu h₁n̥gʷnís tósmōd mélh₃t.
english: Agni ran away from the gods, and went down into the waters. The gods sought him. They did not find him. A goose was swimming. Then it saw him there, and said to them: "Agni is in the water." They said: "Agni, come forth from the water!" Agni said: "I am afraid." Then Agni came forth from it.

pie: h₁ógʷʰis méǵh₂s gʷréh₂us-kʷe h₁ést. wódr̥h₂ péruni Hwért wódr̥h₂-kʷe pró ne yéh₂t. Hrugʰís térst gʷówes-kʷe tr̥syónt. nu gʰrómosyo deywós tód gʷémt. gʷʰént h₁ógʷʰim h₂ḱnéh₁. bʰéydt tód téh₂-kʷe pró dʰénh₂t. nu gʷṓs tósmōd spért. gʷówes h₁léwdʰerōs h₁stā́m. gʰrómos léh₂kt n̥bʰrós-kʷe h₂wérst. nu tósmey méǵh₂ ḱléwos duh₃ént. nu só h₁éḱwōys h₂epó wéǵʰeto. Hrugʰís h₂wékst.
english: The serpent was great and heavy. He shut the waters in the mountain, and the waters were not going forth. The rye dried up, and the cattle were thirsty. Then the god of thunder came to it. He slew the serpent with a stone. He split it, and the waters ran forth. He freed the cattle from it. The cattle were free. The thunder sounded, and the cloud rained. Then they gave him great fame. Then he rode away on horses. The rye grew.

pie: h₁yód h₂nḗr déh₂n̥wi h₃méyǵʰēti déywih₂ tóm gʷʰn̥sḱétu. h₁yós sruméni h₃méyǵʰēti h₂ékʷeh₂es tóm stunédtu. h₁yós múHtrom bʰr̥h₁wéni logʰéyēti só h₂éǵrōd h₂epó léyttu.
english: If a man urinates in the river, let the goddess strike him. Whoever urinates in the stream, let the waters hit him. Whoever puts filth into the spring, let him go away from the field.

pie: deywṓs dyḗm dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe h₂réydʰont. sóh₂wl̥ swóh₁ stóygʰoh₁ stéygʰeti. h₂éwsōs gʷm̥sḱéti tód-kʷe tā́m sékʷetor. wódr̥h₂ dʰubróm móri yéh₂ti. gʷówes-kʷe h₂éǵrom h₁yénti. n̥bʰrós h₂wérst wódr̥h₂-kʷe déh₂nuh₂ pl̥néh₁ti. h₂éboles-kʷe pékʷonti. nu tóh₁ stóygʰoh₁ h₁éyomes.
english: The gods put sky and earth in order. The sun climbs by its own path. Dawn comes, and it follows her. The waters go to the deep sea, and the cattle go to the field. The cloud rains, and the waters fill the rivers, and the apples ripen. Let us go by this path.

pie: dyḗws ǵʰémi ḱéyto só-kʷe gʷréh₂us h₁ést témHos-kʷe h₂én h₁ést. nu méǵh₂s deywós dyḗm dʰéǵʰōm-kʷe wí bʰéydt. tóm úd tl̥néh₂t tóm-kʷe upér stoh₂éyet. dʰéǵʰōm Hn̥dʰí logʰéyet. nu bʰéh₂os h₁nédʰt témHos-kʷe h₂epó léytt. dʰéǵʰōm pl̥th₂éwih₂ h₁ést dyḗws-kʷe méǵh₂s h₁ést.
english: Sky lay on Earth, and he was heavy, and darkness was there. Then a great god split Sky and Earth apart. He lifted it up, and made it stand above. He laid the earth below. Then light came forth, and the darkness went away. The earth was broad, and the sky was great.
